note: Everything here is published for your review. Flagged items and unverified items do NOT block the site from going live. Each item lists the evidence and source links so you can request changes.

items.title: Repository had no application code before this session
items.detail: git ls-files returned only README.md (one line: '# KalshiDash3') at commit 49ba7bc (Initial commit). There was no code, data, tests, license, .gitignore or CI config.

items.title: COORDINATION.md did not exist
items.detail: The task asked for a shared COORDINATION.md. It was created in this session (single agent session on one branch). See COORDINATION.md in the repo root.

items.title: GitHub Pages was publishing the repo root (legacy source main /)
items.detail: Before this session, Pages was configured as build_type legacy, source branch main, path /. The site is now built from the /docs folder, so the Pages source must be switched to main /docs after the merge. This is a settings change you may want to confirm. Pages docs: GitHub 'Configuring a publishing source' (opened and read).

items.title: Branch naming conflict in the task instructions
items.detail: The task asked for per-session branches named session-<id>/<task> and parallel sessions. This session is restricted to one branch (arena/e1b4fe16-kalshidash3), so all work is on that branch and the PR is opened from it. Please confirm this is what you want.

items.title: Escaped characters in the task text
items.detail: The task text contained HTML-escaped fragments such as 'session-&amp;lt;id&amp;gt;/' and '[COORDINATION.md](http://COORDINATION.md)'. They were read as plain 'session-<id>/<task>' and 'COORDINATION.md'.

items.title: Repo hygiene gaps
items.detail: No LICENSE file, no .gitignore, no README description beyond the title. This session added a README-level description, a site build/check script and a CI check. The license choice is left to you.

items.title: Demo prices may not reflect real markets
items.detail: Kalshi's own demo documentation warns that 'the price and behavior of markets in the demo environment may not be reflective of those in real markets.' Every number on this site is demo data.

sources.label: Kalshi docs: Test in the demo environment (opened)

items.title: Stale updated_time on KXBTCMINY markets
items.detail: All three KXBTCMINY-27JAN01 markets report updated_time values from 2026-04-09, while the snapshot was taken 2026-11-20 and the BRTI reference page showed a 2026-11-20 update. Prices on these markets may be stale.

items.title: KXBTCMINY-27JAN01-50000.00: last price is outside the current quote
items.detail: last_price_dollars = 0.5000, but yes_bid = 0.2300 and yes_ask = 0.2400 at the same time. A last trade of 0.50 cannot be verified against the current quote without trade history.

items.title: KXBTCMINY-27JAN01-55000.00: last price is below the current bid
items.detail: last_price_dollars = 0.4000, but yes_bid = 0.4600 and yes_ask = 0.4700 at the same time.

items.title: KXBTCMINY-27JAN01-45000.00: large total volume, zero 24h volume
items.detail: volume_fp = 1,344,878.71 contracts but volume_24h_fp = 0.00. Either no trades in 24h or the 24h figure is stale. Both are possible and cannot be confirmed from this data.

items.title: BTC market rules mention early expiry that the contract PDF does not
items.detail: The market-level rules_secondary says the market resolves early if BRTI crosses the threshold. The series contract terms PDF (BTCMINMAX) describes a payout criterion at a fixed date and time, and does not contain the early-expiry language. The two need to be reconciled by a human reviewer.

items.title: Prop 4 market: ticker date (26NOV03) does not match close date (2027-11-03)
items.detail: KXCABALLOTMEASURES-26NOV03-PR04 has close_time 2027-11-03T04:59:00Z, a year after its 26NOV03 ticker date. Quotes are one-sided (bid 0.00 / ask 1.00) and volume is 3.15 contracts. The official electoral authority link is not captured in the API, so the result source is unverified.

sources.label: Contract terms PDF REFERENDUMPASS (opened, page 1 of 2)

items.title: NATO Secretary General markets use a 'demo strike' placeholder and a wide spread
items.detail: custom_strike = {"demo strike": "demo strike"} on KXNEXTNATOSECGEN-99 markets. Close is 2099-01-08. The Klaus Iohannis market shows bid 0.02 and ask 1.00. Event category is taken from a field the docs mark deprecated.

sources.label: API: open events with nested markets
Kalshi docs: Get Events (opened; category marked deprecated)

items.title: KXXBANNEDGROK has no open markets at check time
items.detail: The series exists (volume 0.00) but GET /markets?series_ticker=KXXBANNEDGROK&status=open returned an empty list.

items.title: Gas-price series show volume but no open markets; sampled markets are finalized
items.detail: KXAAAGASDAL (volume 406.00) and KXAAAGASDAK (volume 61.00) returned no open markets at check time. The markets returned without a status filter were all finalized on 2026-11-13 with result 'no'. The AAA value for that date was not captured, so no value is inferred.

items.title: Observed market status values differ from the documented filter values
items.detail: Market responses showed status 'active' and 'finalized'. The Get Markets docs list status filter values 'unopened', 'open', 'closed', 'settled'. The mapping is not documented on the pages read, so the live dashboard treats any non-empty result as resolved.

sources.label: Kalshi docs: Get Markets (opened, page 1 of 3)

items.title: Settlement-source lists contain placeholder or non-official entries
items.detail: Examples: KXXBANNEDGROK lists 'account holder of ' with a Google search URL, and 'Elon Musk' via x.com. The contract terms PDF lists the account holder as a source agency. KXELONMARS-99 event lists 'official government sources of ' with a kalshi.com URL (blank geography name). Such entries are not official sources.

items.title: Contract PDFs hosted on a staging S3 bucket; some series have empty contract URLs
items.detail: Many series contract_url values point to kalshi-public-docs-staging.s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com. Series KXDOGEPERP has an empty contract_url and the title '100 DOGE'. Confirm which URL is the official one.

items.title: Golf and some crypto settlement sources are media outlets, not governing bodies
items.detail: Series settlement_sources list ESPN, Fox Sports, WSJ and similar outlets for golf series; Bloomberg for KXPRCBTC. Governing-body references (PGA Tour) appear only in some series. Treat these as reference sources, not official ones, until the contract terms are opened and checked.

items.title: AAA values for resolved gas markets were not captured
items.detail: The 10 finalized gas markets are shown with result 'no'. The AAA average for 2026-11-13 is not in this snapshot, so no price comparison is made. The AAA pages opened are dated 11/20/26 (current, not the settlement date).

items.title: Fee schedule read only in part
items.detail: The general fee formula is verified from page 1 of 2 of the fee schedule PDF. The non-standard fee list on that page does not include KXAAAGASDAL, KXAAAGASDAK, KXBTCMINY or the PGA series, but the PDF was not read to its end. Per-series fee multipliers are therefore unconfirmed.

sources.label: Kalshi fee schedule PDF (opened, page 1 of 2)

items.title: BRTI reference value is shown for context only
items.detail: The CF Benchmarks BRTI page showed $61,872.58, last updated 2026-11-20 11:05:28 GMT. This is a reference index, not a market price, and it is not used to compute any table value.

items.title: Browser access to the Kalshi demo API is unverified
items.detail: The live dashboard calls the public demo API from the visitor's browser. The sandbox cannot reach the Kalshi host directly, so CORS behaviour could not be tested here. If the browser is blocked, the dashboard shows an error and the snapshot pages still work.

items.title: Portfolio tracking and trade execution are blocked: no demo API key
items.detail: Kalshi requires authenticated, signed requests for portfolio and order endpoints. Credentials are separate for demo and production. The sandbox has no Kalshi credentials, and creating a demo account and key needs your action. Trades, portfolio performance and strategy results cannot be produced until a demo key is supplied.

sources.label: Kalshi docs: Test in the demo environment (opened)
Kalshi docs: API environments and request signing (opened)

items.title: Full category inventory could not be enumerated in this session
items.detail: Series lists are very large (Crypto about 36 chunks, Economics about 118, Elections about 529, Sports about 851 chunks of about 20k characters each through the fetch tool). The snapshot therefore holds a verified sample, not the full list. The live dashboard loads the full list in the visitor's browser at view time.

items.title: Seconds-level price history is not available from the REST candlesticks endpoint
items.detail: period_interval accepts 1 (one minute), 60 (hour) or 1440 (day). Second-level charts would need the WebSocket feed, which is not built yet.

sources.label: Kalshi docs: Get Market Candlesticks (opened, page 1 of 2)

items.title: Liquidity was checked on one market only
items.detail: The orderbook endpoint was verified on KXBTCMINY-27JAN01-55000.00 (best YES bid 0.46 with 362.31 contracts, matching the market record). Other markets have not been checked. The live dashboard shows the depth of each market the visitor selects.

sources.label: Kalshi docs: Orderbook responses (opened, page 1 of 2)

items.title: Contract-terms PDF or official reference not opened for this row
items.detail: Values in the row come from the API and were checked against the API response. The linked contract-terms PDF or official reference was not opened in this session, so the row is not fully verified against an official source. Opened references are marked on each table row.

items.title: Crypto index references not opened (LINK, AVAX, root CF Benchmarks, Bloomberg)
items.detail: The CF Benchmarks index pages for LINK and AVAX and the Bloomberg page were not opened. Only the BRTI page for Bitcoin was.

items.title: Trade analysis and categorisation cannot run without trade history
items.detail: The analysis section (trade categories, strategy performance) needs fills or trade history from a demo account. None exists yet. See U1.

items.title: Highest-dollar ranking is only a sample
items.detail: The ranking on the Analysis page is computed from the verified sample only. The 'face value' figure is contracts x notional_value_dollars (1.0000 per contract in every sampled binary market). It is not the cash amount traded, which would need trade prices.
